title: Dense LM v1 replicated learning reference
question: What learning, endpoint integrity, generation, and runtime behavior did the frozen dense language-model configuration exhibit across three retained seeds?
mechanisms: Dense decoder-only language model with tied embeddings and no external memory
hypothesis: The fixed configuration produces finite decreasing held-out loss and integrity-bound terminal checkpoints across the three retained seeds.
failure_interpretation: A failed or unavailable seed-level identity, validation, endpoint, generation, or integrity record blocks this bounded reference; out-of-domain chat-card outcomes are descriptive and do not establish TinyStories capability.
controls: Same source package, tokenizer, train/validation data, architecture, optimizer, precision, sequence length, effective batch, and token/step budget across seeds.
confounders: One ROCm/WSL2 device; no cross-device replication.
Captured chat capability cards are out-of-domain for TinyStories.
Fixed training endpoints were reached while loss continued to decrease; no plateau was observed.
hardware_notes: Retained measurements were captured on AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX with PyTorch 2.13.0+rocm10.0.0 under WSL2; portability and energy are unmeasured.
runtime_class: Three-seed single-device training reference; no training, inference, or budget extension is part of this record.
can_establish: A bounded three-seed learning reference with source, tokenizer, data, budget, checkpoint, generation, and runtime provenance.
cannot_establish: General chat quality, architecture superiority, plateau/convergence, cross-hardware efficiency, energy cost, or unmeasured inference performance.
prerequisites: Retained immutable run/checkpoint evidence and static report bundle.
